description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It configures the system to set the current screen based on the request parameters, specifically for performance tracker logging within the HRM system. It uses traits for controller and module screen helpers and overrides the screen for employee performance tracker lists.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements MenuConfigurator to set the current screen to the performance tracker list view based on user requests, specifically for logging performance information.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the screen for performance tracker logs based on the request's 'mode' parameter. Overrides the current module's screen.
